content:
Overview

Shah Alam is a city in Selangor with a population of 740,000. The capital of Selangor, a planned city known for the iconic Sultan Salahuddin Abdul Aziz Mosque and the i-City LED attraction. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
